The eight districts each had a landmark and no loot of their own beyond their sector's spread; each now has a site there (`landmark`), rolled at loot.json's `landmark` tier: its courtyard, top tier, hall, hotel, deck, club, market or block hall, `reach` metres round `at`, on its own floor `y` where it has one (the capsule hotel's galleries are all its floors).
